name: Technical Accuracy
description: Correct behaviour of cwnd: exponential growth in slow start, linear (additive) growth in congestion avoidance, ssthresh halving, different reaction to timeout (reset to 1 MSS) vs three duplicate ACKs (fast retransmit/recovery). No conceptual errors.

name: Completeness
description: Covers all four mechanisms (slow start, congestion avoidance, fast retransmit, fast recovery) and the role of cwnd together with the receiver window.

name: Nomenclature
description: Uses correct standard terms: cwnd, ssthresh, MSS, RTT, ACK, AIMD, RTO, Reno.
